name: Reflect
definition: Attacks from a non-adjacent tile bounce back to the attacker.

name: Flying
definition: Flying units ignore traps, ground and Collision damage.

name: Marked
definition: Marked tiles show where this enemy will act.

name: Charge
definition: At 3 Charge, this enemy's next attack is Arc Lash.

name: Gust
definition: On each Gust beat, each unit is Pushed downwind.

name: Splits
definition: When this enemy dies, this enemy splits into smaller enemies on adjacent tiles.

name: Burst
definition: Destroy the target, then deal X damage on that tile and each adjacent tile.

name: Shape Ground
definition: Place the named ground on each tile in the area.

name: Fire
definition: A unit entering Fire takes 2 damage, and a unit starting on Fire takes 3.

name: Ice
definition: A unit entering Ice or starting a turn on Ice gains Expose 2.

name: Electrified
definition: A Lightning card's hit on an Electrified tile also hits each visible enemy on connected Electrified tiles.

name: Rubble
definition: Leaving Rubble costs 2 Movement.

name: Relocate Ground
definition: Move the ground on one tile to another open tile.

name: Melee
definition: Deal X damage to an adjacent target or a target within the card's Range.

name: Ranged
definition: Deal X damage to a target within Range and line of sight.

name: Pierce
definition: Damage from this attack ignores Block and Stoneskin.

name: Move
definition: Walk up to X tiles.

name: Retreat
definition: This enemy moves up to X tiles away from its target.

name: Blink
definition: Move to a visible open tile up to X tiles away, ignoring intervening tiles.

name: Range
definition: How far this attack reaches in tiles, counted without diagonals.

name: Block
definition: Block absorbs damage until the start of the holder's next turn.

name: Stoneskin
definition: Stoneskin absorbs damage after Block and stays until used up.

name: Heal
definition: Restore X Health.

name: Draw
definition: Draw X cards.

name: Card Play
definition: Spend 1 Card Play per card, refilling each turn and gaining 1 per kill.

name: Follow-up
definition: Gain the Follow-up bonus if you already played a card this turn.

name: Empower
definition: Pay the Empower cost as you play this card to gain the Empower bonus.

name: Stagger
definition: Delay the target's next turn by X Time.

name: Time
definition: Spending Time makes your next turn come later.

name: Illusion
definition: A decoy with X Health that enemies target when at least as close as you.

name: Light
definition: Light reveals within X tiles for the rest of combat and gives enemies starting in Light Expose 2.

name: Vision
definition: For X turns, each hidden enemy is visible to you.

name: Eclipse
definition: The darkest Umbra stage, where you see only your tile and each adjacent tile.

name: Expose
definition: The next hit that damages an Exposed unit deals X more damage.

name: Exhaust
definition: This card leaves your deck until the end of combat.

name: Consume
definition: This item leaves your deck for the rest of the run once played.

name: Retaliate
definition: Until the holder's next turn, melee hits and hits from adjacent tiles deal X damage back.

name: Rite
definition: This card's effect lasts for the rest of combat, and this card Exhausts.

name: Swap
definition: Trade places with a visible enemy or one of your visible Illusions.

name: Cleanse
definition: Remove the listed statuses from yourself.

name: Skate
definition: This turn, Ice costs you no Movement and doesn't Expose you.

name: Anchored
definition: Anchored units can't be moved by Push, Pull or Gust.

name: Fireproof
definition: This turn, Fire doesn't damage you.

name: Convert Ground
definition: Change the chosen ground into the named ground, then damage each enemy on the changed tiles.

name: Sweeping Strike
definition: Hit each visible enemy that meets the named condition.

name: Swap Illusion
definition: Trade places with one of your visible Illusions.

name: Shock
definition: Shocked units can't attack on their next turn.

name: Immobilize
definition: Immobilized units can't Move, Blink or Swap on their next turn.

name: Chain
definition: After each hit, hit 1 new target within X tiles, with Electrified tiles as relays.

name: Push
definition: Move the target X tiles straight away from the source, causing a Collision if blocked.

name: Pull
definition: Move the target X tiles straight toward the source, causing a Collision if blocked.

name: Collision
definition: A blocked Push or Pull deals 2 damage per unmoved tile to the mover and blocker.

name: Health
definition: At 0 Health, a unit is defeated.

name: Health Cost
definition: Lose X Health.

name: Lightning Strikes
definition: This enemy hits each Marked tile, then leaves Electrified on each Marked tile.

name: Summon
definition: This enemy adds the named enemy to combat.

name: Raise Terrain
definition: Raise the named terrain, which blocks movement.

name: Groundsplit
definition: This enemy damages you if you stand within 2 tiles of an Outcrop this enemy raised.

name: Cinder Marks
definition: When this attack lands, you and your Illusions on Marked tiles take X damage, and each Marked tile becomes Fire.

name: Crownfire
definition: This enemy Bursts the Fire on each tile from this enemy's last Cinder Marks.

name: Hollow Gale
definition: This enemy damages you and your Illusions on Marked tiles, then Pushes you 1 tile away.

name: Crystal Mantle
definition: Each Crystal Mantle layer prevents damage from 1 direct hit, then breaks.

name: Guard Ally
definition: This enemy gives X Block to each shown ally.

name: Heal Ally
definition: This enemy restores X Health to the named ally.

name: Last Eclipse
definition: This enemy starts Eclipse for your next X turns, then hits you and your Illusions on Marked tiles.

name: Embers
definition: Currency spent on wares and levels, and dropped when you die.

name: The Run
definition: One journey through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon.

name: Map and Rooms
definition: Choose your route through the section's rooms.

name: Character
definition: Your gear, magic, items and skills.

name: Rewards
definition: After combat, choose a reward.

name: Relics
definition: Passive effects that last the whole run.

name: Combat Board
definition: The 9×9 grid where combat happens.

name: Turn Clock
definition: The unit with the lowest Time acts next, and you act first on a tie.

name: Health and Defenses
definition: Damage hits Block, then Stoneskin, then Health.

name: Defiance
definition: Each Defiance charge saves you from 1 lethal hit and leaves you at 25% Health.

name: Targeting
definition: Attack targets must be visible and within Range. Ranged attacks also need line of sight.

name: Fatigue
definition: Drawing from an empty draw pile shuffles your discard into your draw pile and costs Health.

name: Traps
definition: Traps hit when entered or attacked.

name: The Umbra
definition: Darkness that hides enemies and enemy intents.

name: Fire
definition: Fire cards place Fire and Burst that Fire.

name: Ice
definition: Ice cards place Ice and Burst that Ice.

name: Lightning
definition: Lightning cards place Electrified and spread through Electrified tiles.

name: Air
definition: Air cards Push, Pull and move units.

name: Earth
definition: Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and give Stoneskin.

name: Quick Wits
definition: Once per combat, discard a card to @icon(draw) 1 card. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Measured Breath
definition: At turn end, bank up to one unused @icon(card_play) for your next turn.

name: Ghost Stride
definition: Once per combat, activate to turn your next free Movement into @icon(blink) 2.

name: Discerning Eye
definition: Once between bosses, replace each card in a non-boss combat reward.

name: Rehearsed Escape
definition: Once per combat, activate to discard your next non-item card with @icon(exhaust) instead.

name: Makeshift Tool
definition: Once per combat, activate to discard your next @kw(item) instead of using @icon(consume).

name: Carry the Guard
definition: Once per combat, activate while you have @icon(block). At the end of your turn, that Block becomes @icon(stoneskin).

name: Pain Remembers
definition: After your first @icon(health) loss each combat, return the next non-item discard to your hand if there's room.

name: Sure-Footed
definition: Once per combat, ignore the first @icon(traps) hit or Air @icon(traps) @icon(push) against you.

name: Afterimage
definition: Once per combat, your first @icon(blink) leaves @icon(illusion) 2 on the tile you Blinked from.

name: Deferred Choice
definition: Skip a card reward to save 1 offered card. Replace 1 card in your next non-boss reward with that card.

name: Salvager
definition: Once between bosses, recover the first equipment drop left uncollected after victory.

name: Borrowed Time
definition: The first card paid for with a banked @icon(card_play) each combat adds no @icon(time).

name: Last Reserve
definition: Once per combat, lethal @icon(fatigue) leaves you at @icon(health) 1.

name: Plunderer's Step
definition: The first @icon(move) or @icon(blink) card that collects loot each combat refunds that card's @icon(card_play).

name: Prismatic Instinct
definition: Once per combat, place @icon(surface_fire), @icon(surface_ice), @icon(surface_electrified) or @icon(surface_rubble) within @icon(range) 4. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Curator's Patience
definition: After choosing a relic, save one unchosen relic for your next Relic room.

name: Living Shadow
definition: Once between turns, when your @icon(illusion) is removed, return your latest non-item discard to hand or draw pile if full.

name: True Bearing
definition: Before combat, choose an open starting tile within @icon(range) 2 of the entrance.

name: Encore
definition: Once per combat, return a non-item card from discard to your hand. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Open Arsenal
definition: Equip any equipment in your trinket slot.

name: Confluence
definition: Once per combat, move ground between 2 visible tiles within @icon(range) 4 of you and each other.

name: Last Door
definition: Once between bosses, a non-boss defeat returns you to the previous room at @icon(health) 1.

name: Long Dawn
definition: @icon(vision) you gain lasts 1 more turn.

name: Sunpath
definition: Once per turn, when you @icon(move) or @icon(blink) 3+ tiles, leave @icon(illuminate) 1 on your path.

name: Witchlight
definition: Each of your @icon(illusion|Illusions) creates @icon(illuminate) 1 while that Illusion lasts.

name: Dawnbrand
definition: The first direct attack each turn against an enemy in @icon(illuminate) inflicts @icon(expose) 1.

name: Afterglow
definition: When an @icon(illusion) is removed, leave @icon(illuminate) 1 on that Illusion's tile.

name: Open Sky
definition: While you stand in @icon(illuminate), you have @icon(vision).

name: Skill Point
definition: Earned by leveling up and spent on skills.

name: Moltshards
definition: Won from your first dragon, then traded for Embers or spent to reset your skills.

name: Wait
definition: Each of your first 2 unused Card Plays adds 5 Time to your next turn.

name: Turns
definition: How many of your turns this effect lasts.

name: Movement
definition: Tiles you can walk each turn for free.

name: Item
definition: A one-use card from your item slots.

name: Outcrop
definition: Terrain that blocks movement and can be attacked.

name: Wildfire
definition: On each Wildfire beat, Fire spreads from each Fire tile to the next tile in the named direction.

name: Frostbite
definition: On each Frostbite beat, each unit on Ice takes X damage.

name: Lightning Storm
definition: On each Lightning Storm beat, each unit on an Electrified tile takes X damage.

name: Upheaval
definition: On each Upheaval beat, Marked tiles become Outcrops and move units to free adjacent tiles.

name: Shadowstep
definition: On each Shadowstep beat, each hidden enemy Blinks toward you if there is room.
